name: tlm-kalendar
description: Zagreb Traditional Latin Mass calendar and daily missal, 2026-2036 (1962 Missal)

scripts.build: tsx scripts/croatian/build-manual.ts && tsx scripts/build/build.ts && tsx scripts/igra/build.ts
scripts.deploy: npm run build && git add -A && (git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -m "Update site") && git push origin main
scripts.crawl: tsx scripts/verify/crawl.ts file && tsx scripts/verify/crawl.ts http && tsx scripts/verify/startup.ts
scripts.check: npm test && npm run crawl && npm run verify:site && npm run verify:igra
scripts.verify:igra: tsx scripts/igra/verify-data.ts && tsx scripts/igra/button.ts && tsx scripts/igra/layout.ts && tsx scripts/igra/quality.ts
scripts.play:igra: tsx scripts/igra/play.ts chromium && tsx scripts/igra/play.ts webkit
scripts.verify:site: tsx scripts/verify/font-shape.ts && tsx scripts/verify/site-url.ts && tsx scripts/verify/site-keys.ts && tsx scripts/verify/site-layout.ts && tsx scripts/verify/font-render.ts
